page.layout: One printed page (page 39). One column of running text, with a narrow margin of cropped notes on the left. Running head at top. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: quod libros illos aut Episcopos tangeret, quo re-Nobilibus[?] sponso, delusos, ac vana spe lactatos, cum se cerne-Baronibus[?] rent deputati, nomine omnium Regni civium, qui-us, vel[?] bus haec res cordi fuit, protestationem contra Sena-mex[?] tum regium parant, seque, pacificis omnibus mediis deput[?] frustra tentatis, Ecclesiis deesse non posse declarant, nique[?] si quis porro exoriretur in prosecutione causae hu-deputi[?] jus tumultus, soli Senatui ob negatam justitiam im-in hors[?] putandus esset.. Quod cum Senatui regio subole-er unive[?] ret, nec ignoraret, quam proxima fumo esset flam-et rem[?] ma, Episcopis (ut fertur) primum monitis, ut se à d prop[?] Senatu pro tempore subducerent; deputatis com-us, &[?] parendi licentiam concedit, qui quia sciebant diffi-ement[?] cilem esse in Senatum ingressum, ante januam Pal-m, ct[?] latii Dalkethensis (quo in oppido tum cogebantur) redd[?] praestolabantur, ut Senatoribus saltem egredienti-ea ex[?] bus protestationem insinuarent.

Vbi comparuere Deputati in Senatu, omnium x stat[?] nomine verba fecit nobilis Dominus de Lowdon, Vice- n &p[?] comes Avrensis, singulari facundia & animi constantia explicabat, quid ab initio libellorum supplicum Senatui exhibitorum actum fuisset, quae ipsorum causae, quam modeste ac patienter Regis optimi clementiam expectassent, & quorum artibus quod ea non fruantur factum sit, paratos se contra Epi-im m[?] scopos actionem instituere, institutamque prosequi, rere[?] qua se probaturos suscipiunt eosdem gravissimo-eor[?] rum criminum reos esse, idque sub capitum, hono-con[?] rum, fortunarum suarum periculo, & poena, si in x ou[?] probatione deficient, aut coram aequis judicibus it, t[?] causa cadent, aequitatem itaque postulare, ut a Se-rer[?] natu regio excluderentur Episcopi, donec de ipso-per[?] rum innocentia constiterit: esse absurdum, eosdem ficct[?] habere judices & adversarios, denique. Senatores m[?] regios obtestatur, ut procrastinationibus omnibus &c[?] posthabitis, tandem aliquando aliquid hac in causa

page.notes: The left margin is cropped at the scan edge: most marginal notes are only fragments and are transcribed as far as legible, with [?]. Their exact words cannot be recovered. Paragraph 2 margin fragments are especially uncertain and their line positions are approximate. The bottom line "facc-" is the catchword, and "C 4" is the signature. The running head is "IN REGNO SCOT."; the year 1637 is not included. Long s is written as s throughout; the scan's "f" in "fponfo" and "fruftra" was read as s.
